title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer Sr
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Cloud Platform Engineer , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Atuação na região Central - Polo CTO no modelo hibrido

Nessa função você vai:

No Itaú, as plataformas de IA e GenAI já operam em escala real, suportando modelos fundacionais, agentes autônomos, pipelines de inferência e workloads intensivos em computação.

O grande desafio da nossa squad é claro:

Reduzir o Time-to-Market de projetos de Dados, IA e Inovação, garantindo plataformas cloud robustas, seguras, eficientes e automatizadas, prontas para suportar alta demanda de compute, dados sensíveis e integrações complexas.

Essa vaga é para quem quer atuar no core da engenharia de plataformas de IA construindo a infraestrutura que viabiliza LLMs, agentes e RAG em produção com confiabilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos.

Ser a pessoa engenheira responsável por habilitar os recursos necessários para provisionamento de plataformas de IA, como recursos e serviços em Cloud garantindo que times de produto consigam colocar soluções de IA em produção com velocidade e segurança.

Aqui, cloud não é apenas infraestrutura. É plataforma de aceleração de IA.

Como Cloud é tratado aqui / Cloud não é tratado como:

  • Provisionamento manual
  • Ambientes isolados por projeto
  • Infraestrutura estática
  • Cloud aqui é:
  • Padronizada e reutilizável
  • Infraestrutura como codigo, desde o design
  • Base para workloads de IA escaláveis e observáveis
  • Fundamento para custo eficiente em compute intensivo

O que você vai construir

  • Plataformas cloud para IA e GenAI, suportando:
  • LLMs, agentes autônomos, RAG e pipelines de inferência
  • Ambientes de treino, experimentação e produção
  • Arquiteturas cloud escaláveis e resilientes, cobrindo:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud
  • Ambientes containerizados e orquestrados:
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)
  • oIngress controllers, service mesh e load balancing L4/L7
  • Infraestrutura como Codigo (IaC):
  • Terraform e CloudFormation
  • Padrões reutilizáveis e versionados
  • Pipelines CI/CD e automação:
  • Deploy de aplicações, modelos e infra
  • Integração com fluxos de MLOps / AIOps
  • Observabilidade completa de plataformas de IA:
  • Monitoramento, logging, tracing
  • Troubleshooting de workloads distribuídos
  • Otimização de custos em IA (FinOps):
  • Compute intensivo (GPU/CPU)
  • Dimensionamento eficiente para treino e inferência
  • Networking cloud avançado:
  • VPC/VNet, subnets, routing e DNS
  • Load Balancers, ingress e service exposure
  • Conectividade híbrida (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)

Perfil que buscamos

  • Já construiu ou operou plataformas cloud em ambientes críticos
  • Entende que IA exige infra diferente de sistemas tradicionais
  • Gosta de trabalhar com segurança, automação, padrão e escala
  • Consegue equilibrar:
  • Performance
  • Confiabilidade
  • Custo
  • Tem visão de cloud como produto de plataforma, não apenas como ambiente

Conhecimentos essenciais

  • IA e GenAI:
  • LLMs, agentes, RAG
  • Entendimento do ciclo de vida de IA: dados ¿ treino ¿ modelos ¿ inferência
  • Plataformas Cloud:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Containers e orquestração:
  • Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infraestrutura como Cdigo:
  • Terraform, CloudFormation
  • CI/CD e automação
  • Observabilidade e troubleshooting
  • FinOps e otimização de custo em compute intensivo
  • Networking cloud e conectividade híbrida:
  • VPC/VNet, DNS, routing
  • Load balancers L4/L7, ingress controllers
  • VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute

Por que essa vaga é estratégica

  • Você vai habilitar IA em escala, não s subir infraestrutura
  • Seu trabalho reduz lead time, não s incidentes
  • Cloud tratado como plataforma e acelerador de inovação
  • Atuação em problemas reais de IA em produção, não apenas POCs

title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Region/Country Tire Sales Manager

Location: South America Region

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Tire Sales Manager with a strong background in selling semi-steel products. The ideal candidate will have significant experience in managing or working with retail tire stores and will be responsible for expanding our presence in this sector, driving sales growth, and building long-term relationships with clients.

- Achieve sales targets and regularly report on performance metrics to management.

- A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in tire sales, with a focus on Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire products.

- Strong experience in retail store management or sales within the tire industry.

- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing long-term client relationships.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

-Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize tasks.

- Knowledge of the tire industry and market trends is essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Previous experience in opening new retail accounts and developing retail store networks.

- Familiarity with market dynamics and customer needs in the Passenger Car Radial(PCR) tire segment.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Piece

Piece is a holding company that acquires vertical software/AI businesses and scales them through creator-powered distribution. We believe the next Latin American giants will emerge at the intersection of AI and creator economy — software brings technology, recurring revenue, and LTV; creators bring audience, trust, and distribution. Piece brings them together.

Our edge is a proprietary creator-focused distribution engine that uses AI to automate growth across our vertical software portfolio — social media, sales funnels, content, and creator operations. Every vertical we add makes the machine smarter, compounding proprietary data on what works in creator-led distribution for AI/Software. Our goal is to hit US$10M ARR in 2026.

We're building Piece to be a home for some of the most exceptional people in the world. Talent density is non-negotiable, the bar is unreasonably high, and we expect excellence in everything we ship. Our ambition is to put Brazil on the map as a global protagonist in growth and distribution.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to be the technical pillar of the product at the first and main company in our portfolio — someone who combines technical depth with product sense, and who will own the architecture, evolution, and operation of its entire backend and AI infrastructure.

You'll be hands-on building and scaling the systems that orchestrate our agents, process messages in real time, and sustain the platform's accelerated growth. This isn't a maintenance role — it's a building role.

If you enjoy solving complex problems in distributed systems, have a genuine interest in applied AI, and want to build something that's reshaping how the Brazilian legal market operates, this is the place. You'll join as part of our founding team, with competitive compensation and meaningful equity through stock options.

What you'll do

Backend architecture and evolution

  • Design and evolve the microservices that power the platform, with a focus on scalability and maintainability
  • Make technical decisions autonomously — database modeling, API design, stack choices
  • Raise the team's technical bar through code review and mentorship

AI agents and LLMs

  • Build and evolve our agent pipelines: orchestration, tool calling, dynamic workflows, and intelligent routing
  • Optimize cost and latency of LLM calls without compromising quality
  • Evolve our RAG, document processing, and voice synthesis features

Integrations and operations

  • Ensure reliability of asynchronous message flows and external integrations
  • Build new integrations as the product evolves
  • Maintain operational stability in a multi-tenant system with paying customers

Quality and observability

  • Ensure end-to-end traceability across synchronous and asynchronous flows
  • Structure operational metrics and maintain visibility over agent behavior in production
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they become incidents

What we expect from you

Backend & Systems

  • Proficiency with Node.js + TypeScript in high-throughput production systems — including API design, modular architecture, and long-term maintainability decisions
  • Strong grasp of event-driven and asynchronous architectures: message queues, pub/sub patterns, idempotency, retry logic, and failure isolation in distributed systems
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS backends: data isolation strategies, per-tenant configuration, and operational complexity at scale
  • Solid database modeling — relational (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and NoSQL (document modeling, consistency trade-offs) — and ability to choose the right store for the problem
  • Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred): Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, IAM, and observability tooling

AI & Agent Systems

  • Experience building LLM-powered pipelines in production — not just calling APIs, but thinking through orchestration, context management, fallback behavior, and output reliability
  • Understanding of agent architectures: tool calling, multi-step reasoning, routing logic, state management across turns, and how to make agents predictable in real-world conditions
  • Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding selection, retrieval quality, and reranking — and awareness of where RAG breaks down
  • Cost and latency awareness in LLM usage: prompt engineering for efficiency, model selection trade-offs, caching strategies, and when not to use an LLM
  • Familiarity with evaluation and observability for AI systems: how to measure agent quality, detect regressions, and maintain visibility over non-deterministic behavior in production

Product & Technical Judgment

  • Ability to reason about product trade-offs, not just technical ones — understands what to build, what to cut, and why
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity: capable of going from a fuzzy problem to a concrete technical proposal without needing a fully-specced ticket
  • Has opinions about prioritization and isn't just an executor — questions requirements upstream and thinks about user and business impact before writing the first line of code

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.

The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.

This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment

What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking

Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)

Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy

Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora, são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

title: Community, Partnership & Development Manager

The International Baccalaureate provides world-class educational services to over 6,000 schools across 160 countries. A career with the IB is not just a job; it’s an opportunity to work with an innovative world leader in education services where we empower our employees to thrive and make a difference.

This role manages day-to-day partnerships across a defined portfolio of schools, groups, districts and/or school systems to support effective IB programme implementation, portfolio health and sustainable growth. The Community Partnerships & Development (CP&D) Manager contributes to the successful adoption, delivery and development of IB programmes by managing stakeholder engagement, coordinating implementation support, and using portfolio insight to improve partner outcomes.   • Familiarity with public, private and/or international education systems.
  • IB Educator Network experience or other IB‑related roles desirable.
  • Fluency in English; additional languages desirable.

title: Designer Gráfico — Consultoria em Negócios Jurídicos B2B
description:
Sobre a Javali

A Javali é uma consultoria de negócios jurídicos. Ajudamos escritórios de advocacia empresarial a crescerem com estratégia, conteúdo e posicionamento. Não somos agência de marketing. Trabalhamos lado a lado com sócios de escritórios que faturam milhões e precisam de inteligência de mercado para se diferenciar e não apenas de posts bonitos para Instagram.

Somos um time pequeno, com profundidade alta no mercado. Nossos clientes são exigentes, trabalhamos temas sofisticados, com impacto visual visível. Quem entra aqui tem autonomia real e responsabilidade proporcional.

Esta vaga combina com você se…

• Você quer executar dentro de um padrão visual já definido, com agilidade e atenção a detalhes e não esteja procurando posição para liderar direção criativa ou comandar equipe.

• Você é designer gráfico aplicado a marketing, com experiência em criação de peças de redes sociais, e-books, apresentações comerciais e não está em transição para UX/UI ou Product Design.

• Você domina as ferramentas certas para cada entrega, sem fanatismo. Se você acredita que "ferramenta X é a única séria" e não usa o resto, você vai se frustar aqui.

• Você tem ao menos 1 ano de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer ou ainda fez um estágio único de 12+ meses contínuos com responsabilidades reais. Aqui você vai aplicar o que já sabe;

• Sua estética é corporativa, institucional, sóbria. Se seu portfólio mostra cuidado com hierarquia, clareza e linguagem visual profissional, vai casar bem.

O que você vai fazer
  • Produção diária de peças gráficas para uma carteira de clientes (escritórios de advocacia). O trabalho é volume com qualidade dentro de padrão.
  • Peças para redes sociais (50% do tempo). Posts, stories, carrosséis e capas para LinkedIn (principal canal B2B jurídico) e Instagram. Você adapta a partir de templates e diretrizes visuais já definidas para cada cliente. Não é criação do zero o tempo todo. É execução inteligente dentro de um padrão.
  • Diagramação de materiais (30% do tempo). E-books de 30+ páginas, apresentações comerciais, propostas, newsletters, relatórios e materiais institucionais. Conteúdo chega pronto ou semi-pronto. Seu papel é transformar texto denso em layouts limpos. Clareza e ritmo de leitura importam mais do que efeito visual.
  • Adaptações e desdobramentos (15% do tempo). Adaptar peças entre formatos e plataformas, ajustar materiais existentes, criar variações a partir de um key visual aprovado.
  • Organização de arquivos (5% do tempo). Manter pastas organizadas, nomear arquivos corretamente, respeitar padrões de entrega. Parte do método.
Stack esperada
  • Base sólida: Photoshop e Illustrator em nível intermediário a avançado (tratamento de imagem, vetorização, ajustes finos).
  • Produção ágil: familiaridade com ferramentas de criação rápida para volume de social e materiais simples (Canva Pro, Figma ou equivalentes).
  • Apresentações: PowerPoint ou Google Slides para institucional e comercial.
  • Diferencial real: InDesign para diagramação editorial densa, motion (After Effects, CapCut), IA generativa aplicada a design, experiência prévia em mercado jurídico, financeiro ou serviços profissionais.
Requisitos não negociáveis

1 a 5 anos de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer gráfico

• Portfólio acessível (link de Behance, Dribbble, site pessoal ou PDF)

• Capacidade de trabalhar com volume, múltiplos clientes e prazos curtos sem perder qualidade

• Atenção a detalhes: revisão de textos nas peças, alinhamentos, consistência entre formatos

• Disponibilidade para híbrido em SP (presencial 3x/semana na região do Paraíso)

• Aceita contratação PJ

Processo seletivo

Triagem por currículo + portfólio · Entrevista · Teste prático visual · Conversa final.

O que oferecemos

• Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado

• Modelo híbrido (presencial em SP, 3x por semana + remoto)

• Autonomia real: você terá clientes e entregas sob sua responsabilidade

• Exposição a um nicho de alta complexidade e alto valor — negócios jurídicos é um mercado que você dificilmente encontra em outro lugar

• Espaço para crescer. Quem entra e entrega, evolui rápido.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

Sobre nós

Sobre o Publicis Groupe Referência em inovação, criatividade e respeito às diferenças, o Publicis Groupe é o grupo de comunicação mais valorizado no mercado. Com 100 mil colaboradores atuando em mais de 100 países - e interconectados pela plataforma de IA Marcel -, somos um parceiro estratégico no processo de transformação de nossos clientes. Atuamos com base na filosofia do Power of One, que permite que as marcas avancem na personalização em escala e encontrem todos os serviços de que precisam no mesmo lugar, com a possibilidade de customizá-los de acordo com suas demandas. No Brasil, o Publicis Groupe conta com 2.500 colaboradores divididos em agências de publicidade e empresas especialistas que são referências em suas áreas de atuação: DPZ, LePub, Leo, Publicis Brasil, Talent, ARC, BR Media, Epsilon, PMX, Publicis Production e Publicis Edge.

Resumo da posição

A pessoa Supervisora de Mídia será responsável por liderar a execução e a operação de campanhas de mídia integradas, atuando de forma híbrida entre digital e off. Terá papel central na gestão do time, controle de processos, acompanhamento de resultados e garantia da qualidade das entregas, sempre alinhada aos objetivos de negócio do cliente.

O que buscamos

  • Supervisionar a implementação, acompanhamento e otimização de campanhas digitais e offiline;

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre planejamento, BI, criação, atendimento, veículos e plataformas;

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, promovendo boas práticas e consistência nas entregas;
  • Participar de apresentações e alinhamentos com clientes e lideranças internas.

  • Conhecimento em processos financeiros;

  • Acostumado em lidar com rotina de apresentações junto ao cliente;

Informações adicionais

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações afetivas, raças, etnias, idades, religiões, pessoas com deficiência, entre outras. Acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem soluções mais criativas e humanas.

Nosso compromisso com você

No Publicis Groupe, acreditamos que o sucesso começa com pessoas bem cuidadas, ouvidas e inspiradas. Aqui, nos preocupamos com a sua jornada, por isso, trazemos alguns dos pilares que sustentam nossa cultura:

  • Integridade, rastreabilidade e qualidade de dados

  • Analisar riscos associados a APIs, integrações sistêmicas e arquiteturas modernas, como microsserviços.
  • Avaliar governança, riscos e controles relacionados ao uso corporativo de Inteligência Artificial, incluindo:
  • Machine Learning e Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Governança do ciclo de vida de modelos e dados
  • Uso de modelos via APIs e protocolos como MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Elaborar relatórios de auditoria claros e objetivos, com achados, impacto e recomendações práticas.

  • Familiaridade com Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), CI/CD pipelines, automação e APIs.
  • Conhecimento em riscos e controles relacionados a Inteligência Artificial e governança de modelos.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Diferenciais

  • Certificação CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) ou CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados.
  • Vivência com auditorias envolvendo Cloud, DevOps, Data & AI.
  • Outras certificações em Segurança da Informação, Cloud ou Governança de TI.

title: Technical Business Analyst - FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

title: Outbound Growth Hunter — Business Development Representative
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech

startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential

through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with

founders to deliver high-impact design solutions — from MVP design sprints to full-scale product

interface design and UX audits.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a relentless, resourceful hunter who doesn't wait for leads to come to them.

You won't inherit a playbook — you'll write one. If you've built pipeline from scratch, found

decision-makers nobody handed you, and converted cold conversations into real opportunities,

this role is for you. Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by the chase, and sharp enough to

earn a founder's attention in three sentences or less.

You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers — primarily

founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies. You'll play a critical role in

connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

• Source qualified leads independently using any channel that works — LinkedIn,

communities, events, cold email, social, referrals, or whatever creative approach you

invent. No channel is off-limits.

• Own the full top-of-funnel — from identifying a name to booking a call — without relying

on inbound or handed leads.

• Develop and test your own outreach experiments; own the results and iterate fast.

• Find creative angles to reach founders — conference attendee lists, community posts,

funding announcements, product launches — and turn them into booked conversations.

• Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities

• Track activities and performance using CRM tools

• Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in

SaaS or agency environments)

• Proven ability to book meetings with cold prospects — share examples of creative

outreach that worked

• Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

• A track record of sourcing your own leads, not just working a provided list

• Comfortable operating without a defined system — you build your own process, manage

your own time, and hold yourself accountable to results

• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)

• Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely

• English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)

Nice to Have

• Experience selling design, product, or digital services

• Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development

• Experience working with early-stage startups or founders

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work to identify high-impact projects at fast-growing SaaS and tech

companies, helping shape the digital tools that empower businesses worldwide. Your

contributions will be significant in driving growth for the business, with outcomes of your efforts

making a clear impact. This is an opportunity to take the step in your career in a studio that

values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

This is not a role with rigid scripts or assigned lead lists. You'll have full creative freedom to find

and engage the right clients in whatever way works — we care only about results. If you've ever

felt constrained by a playbook, you’ll love working at Foundey.

title: Head of IT
description:
About us

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is a fully owned subsidiary of Hapag-Lloyd. Operating from Rotterdam, HGT manages a portfolio of stakes in 23 terminals and complementary logistics services across 13 countries across 5 continents: Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa - with plans to expand its stakes to over ~30 terminals by 2030.

Spanning key regions, its portfolio comprises port terminals and related logistics services operated by Hanseatic Global Terminals Latin America in Latin America and Florida (USA), and, in the booming Indian market, it is present through the container terminals, depots and rail business of J M Baxi, India’s largest integrated terminal and logistics provider. Additionally, HGT’s presence in strategic European hubs, such as Germany, France and the Mediterranean, enhances its global network and allows it to offer seamless, efficient logistics and supply chain solutions to customers worldwide.

At HGT, we are a highly motivated team of experienced international professionals who believe that growth in any partnership comes from trust and dedication. Our commitment to provide highly efficient terminal operations that are safe, sustainable, and reliable is rooted in a simple yet powerful vision: “offering exceptional service quality at all times.”

The project: Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz port terminal:

Hanseatic Global Terminals (HGT) is embarking on an exciting new chapter with the development of Hanseatic Global Terminals Aracruz , a state‑of‑the‑art container terminal created in partnership with the Imetame Group. Following HGT’s recent agreement to acquire 50% of the shares in Imetame Logística Porto (ILP) , this joint venture marks a significant strategic investment in Brazil’s evolving port landscape and will play a key role in strengthening global supply chain connectivity.

Located in Aracruz, Espírito Santo, the new terminal is designed to be a modern transshipment and gateway hub for the region. Expected to launch operations by mid‑2028, the facility will feature a capacity of approximately 1.2 million TEU, 750 meters of quay, advanced cargo‑handling technology, and 17 meters of water depth, enabling the efficient handling of the industry’s largest vessels.

As HGT and the Imetame Group work together to build and operate this future‑ready terminal, we are assembling a team of talented professionals who will help shape the next major milestone in Brazil’s port infrastructure development. The project represents an opportunity to be part of a transformational venture that will set new standards for performance, innovation, and operational excellence.

The position

The Head of IT is responsible for designing, implementing, and operating the full IT landscape required to support both the construction phase and the future operation of the terminal.

The role ensures the delivery of a secure, scalable, and standardized IT environment, aligned with HGT global standards and Imetame Group requirements, across infrastructure, networks, enterprise applications, cybersecurity, and data platforms.

During the construction phase, the position focuses on defining the IT architecture, leading vendor selection and implementation, and ensuring readiness for operations.

Over time, the role evolves into overseeing steady-state IT operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and continuous improvement.

The Head of IT reports to the Project Director during the project phase, transitioning to the Terminal/Site Managing Director closer to go-live. The role also maintains a dotted-line to the Senior Director, Global IT at HGT and to the senior IT leadership of Imetame Group.

The role is based in Brazil, site-based, with regional and occasional international travel.

Key Responsibilities

IT Strategy & Governance

  • Define and implement the local IT strategy aligned with HGT global IT governance and standards.
  • Establish the IT operating model (hub-and-spoke), including roles, responsibilities, and decision rights.
  • Ensure alignment with corporate cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance frameworks.
  • Act as the primary interface between local operations and global IT.

Technology Architecture & Implementation

  • Define the end-to-end IT architecture covering:
  • Data centers and cloud infrastructure
  • Enterprise and OT networks
  • Cybersecurity controls and monitoring
  • End-user computing and collaboration tools
  • Core business applications (ERP, EAM, TOS integrations, etc.)
  • Lead procurement processes, including RFP/RFQ preparation, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Oversee implementation of all IT systems, ensuring alignment with project timelines and operational requirements.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Ensure implementation of cybersecurity controls aligned with global policies and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001).
  • Oversee identity and access management, endpoint protection, network security, and SOC integration.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure mitigation plans are in place.
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and global standards.

IT Operations & Service Management

  • Establish IT service management processes (incident, problem, change, and asset management).
  • Implement and oversee IT Service Desk and support model (potentially 24/7).
  • Ensure high availability and resilience of IT services, including backup and disaster recovery.
  • Manage IT vendors, service providers, and SLAs.

Data & Digital Enablement

  • Enable data platforms and reporting capabilities to support operational and financial decision-making.
  • Promote data governance and data quality practices.
  • Support digital and automation opportunities (including AI use cases), in coordination with the terminal OT Lead role.

Project & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a core member of the project team, aligning IT delivery with construction milestones.
  • Coordinate with engineering, operations, finance, and external stakeholders.
  • Communicate IT progress, risks, and performance to senior management and board-level stakeholders.

Transition to Operations

  • Ensure full IT readiness for terminal go-live.
  • Support transition from project phase to steady-state operations.
  • Build and lead the local IT organization.

Job requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in IT leadership roles, preferably in ports, logistics, or industrial environments.
  • Strong understanding of port terminal operational systems and processes (e.g., TOS, yard operations, gate systems, vessel planning).
  • Proven experience in large-scale IT implementations (infrastructure, applications, and integrations).
  • Strong understanding of:
  • IT infrastructure and cloud environments
  • Enterprise applications (ERP, EAM, etc.)
  • Cybersecurity and risk management
  • IT service management frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
  • Experience working in global, matrix organizations with distributed teams.
  • Strong vendor management and procurement experience.
  • Ability to operate in greenfield or transformation environments.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to shape the IT foundation of a new world-class terminal.
  • High-impact leadership role in a global, fast-growing organization.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in port and logistics operations.

Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.

The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.

This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.

What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.

Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.

What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime

How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Business Analyst - Financial Crimes / Process Engineering
description:
Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong experience in Financial Crimes and Process Engineering to support transformation initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with Compliance, Operations and Technology teams to map current processes, design future-state operating models, document requirements and support the implementation of improved, controlled and audit-ready processes.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with AML, KYC, Sanctions , process discovery, process mapping, AS-IS/TO-BE design, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, controls documentation and UAT support.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead workshops with Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders.
  • Map AS-IS processes and design TO-BE processes with focus on efficiency, control and regulatory alignment.
  • Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process rules and data rules.
  • Support backlog prioritization and dependency management.
  • Define KPIs, success measures and process improvement opportunities.
  • Support the design of controls and evidence required for audit and regulatory purposes.
  • Partner with data and technology teams to ensure data quality and accurate system integrations.
  • Support UAT, functional validation and go-live readiness.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, including process flows, SOPs, RACI and data lineage.
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making between business and technology teams.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst .
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Financial Crimes , such as:
  • AML
  • KYC
  • Sanctions
  • Transaction monitoring
  • Compliance operations
  • Experience with process engineering , process discovery and process optimization.
  • Hands-on experience mapping AS-IS and TO-BE processes .
  • Experience with BPMN or similar process modeling notation.
  • Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with controls, risk management, regulatory expectations and audit-ready documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Compliance, Operations and Technology.
  • Experience supporting UAT, testing and go-live readiness.
  • Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps, TFS, Jira or Confluence.
  • Advanced English for interaction with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management or consulting.
  • Six Sigma, Lean or process improvement certification.
  • Knowledge of data lineage, data quality and control frameworks.
  • Experience creating SOPs, RACI matrices and operational procedures.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt knowledge or certification.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a Business Analyst with strong process improvement experience and real exposure to Financial Crimes . This is not a purely technical BA role and not a generic process analyst position. We are looking for someone who understands AML/KYC/Sanctions processes, can lead workshops, document requirements, map AS-IS/TO-BE processes, support UAT and help create controlled, audit-ready documentation.

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

Gerenciar de forma remota uma carteira de clientes, promovendo atendimento consultivo, suporte técnico-comercial e execução eficiente do ciclo de vendas internas. O que você precisa ter:

title: Assistente de TI
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Pharma Nectar tem uma trajetória que começou em 1980, com a Apiário Nectar, dedicando quase três décadas à busca pelos melhores produtos provenientes das abelhas. Em 1990, fundamos a Nectar Farmacêutica e expandimos nosso alcance ao mercado internacional, incorporando biotecnologia, fitoterapia e farmácia de manipulação. Reconhecida por sua qualidade e compromisso com a excelência, a empresa exporta para países como Japão, Estados Unidos, Europa e África. Nosso foco está no atendimento farmacêutico individualizado e na pesquisa e desenvolvimento de produtos inovadores a partir de moléculas naturais, promovendo saúde, prevenção e melhoria na qualidade de vida dos nossos clientes.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para o cargo de Suporte Técnico em Belo Horizonte, MG. Este cargo é responsável por resolver problemas técnicos, oferecer suporte à equipe, gerenciar questões de tecnologia da informação e atender solicitações relacionadas às necessidades de hardware e software. As responsabilidades também incluem suporte a impressoras e diagnóstico de falhas técnicas, garantindo a continuidade das operações no local. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e exige atuação presencial.
Qualificações
  • Suporte Técnico: Conhecimento em suporte técnico e em atendimento a usuários, com foco em soluções práticas e eficientes para problemas técnicos.
  • Tecnologia da Informação: Experiência em processos de TI, manutenção de hardware e software, e gestão de sistemas operacionais diversos.
  • Suporte a Impressoras e Solução de Problemas: Habilidade para oferecer suporte técnico a equipamentos de impressão e realizar diagnósticos e correções de falhas.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Competência na análise de problemas e na proposição de soluções de forma rápida e eficaz.
  • Formação em áreas como tecnologia da informação ou informática será considerada um diferencial, assim como certificações técnicas relevantes.

title: Consultor de Vendas-Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo demandas de infraestrutura, indústria, hotelaria, varejo, facilities comerciais e compras baseadas em projetos.

Diferente das plataformas tradicionais focadas apenas na venda de produtos, a SolutionMall concentra-se na entrega estruturada de soluções , incluindo:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos do cliente
  • Seleção de produtos adequados
  • Correspondência entre demanda e solução
  • Coordenação com fornecedores
  • Suporte em cotações
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades e projetos

Na área de soluções para eletrodomésticos comerciais , a SolutionMall atende uma ampla gama de produtos e sistemas utilizados em hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e instalações públicas.

Nossa cobertura de soluções pode incluir:

  • Máquinas de lavar e secadoras comerciais
  • Equipamentos para lavanderias self-service
  • Refrigeradores comerciais e expositores refrigerados
  • Equipamentos de refrigeração para supermercados
  • Expositores de bebidas
  • Displays comerciais e sinalização digital
  • Aquecedores de água para hotéis e aplicações comerciais
  • Lava-louças comerciais e equipamentos de limpeza
  • Equipamentos para cozinhas industriais
  • Ar-condicionado comercial e sistemas de ventilação
  • Sistemas de exaustão para cozinhas
  • Sistemas de renovação de ar
  • Pias, áreas de lavagem, bancadas e equipamentos auxiliares em aço inoxidável
  • Pacotes integrados de eletrodomésticos comerciais para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias e facilities

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios da SolutionMall no Brasil.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que possuam recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos seguintes setores:

  • Eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Equipamentos para hotéis
  • Equipamentos para restaurantes
  • Equipamentos para supermercados
  • Equipamentos de lavanderia
  • HVAC
  • Cozinhas industriais
  • Refrigeração comercial
  • Fornecimento de equipamentos para facilities
  • Distribuição B2B de equipamentos

O foco principal da função é desenvolver oportunidades locais, identificar demandas reais de compra, apoiar o desenvolvimento de RFQs e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções comerciais no mercado brasileiro.

Temos interesse especial em candidatos que compreendam a diferença entre equipamentos de uso comercial e eletrodomésticos residenciais comuns .

O candidato ideal deverá apoiar atividades como:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Comunicação com canais e distribuidores
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • Coordenação de RFQs e cotações
  • Promoção de soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Coleta de feedback do mercado local
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Esta não é uma função de venda no varejo de eletrodomésticos residenciais. Trata-se de uma função de desenvolvimento de negócios B2B , focada em equipamentos comerciais, projetos e aplicações de uso contínuo e profissional.

3) Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver oportunidades locais de clientes e canais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e projetos de facilities.
  • Promover soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais, como equipamentos de lavanderia, refrigeração, cozinhas industriais, lava-louças, aquecedores de água, displays, HVAC, exaustão e sistemas de ventilação.
  • Acompanhar necessidades dos clientes, RFQs, cotações, seleção de produtos e progresso dos projetos.
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipe da SolutionMall, fornecedores, distribuidores e contatos de projeto.
  • Compartilhar feedback do mercado brasileiro sobre tendências de demanda, preços, concorrentes, hábitos de compra e oportunidades de canais.

4) Qualificações

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em eletrodomésticos comerciais, equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, refrigeração, lavanderia comercial, cozinhas industriais, HVAC, ventilação ou vendas B2B de equipamentos.
  • Familiaridade com equipamentos de uso comercial e capacidade de compreender necessidades dos clientes, seleção de produtos, acompanhamento de RFQs e coordenação de cotações.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e habilidade para desenvolver clientes locais, distribuidores, empreiteiros, integradores ou contatos de projeto no Brasil.
  • Experiência com hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, empresas de facilities ou distribuidores de equipamentos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Recursos existentes de clientes ou canais no Brasil serão uma forte vantagem.
  • Inglês profissional para comunicação de negócios será considerado um diferencial.
  • Português fluente é necessário para comunicação local no Brasil.

5) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios.

As principais áreas de atuação incluem:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações
  • Comunicação sobre produtos e soluções
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso dos projetos e contribuição comercial real.

6) Benefícios da Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e à contribuição comercial real, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Avanço de RFQs
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Progresso de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios

Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional e contribuição para projetos.

7) Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn ou envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:

Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais – Brasil

title: DESENHISTA PROJETISTA JR
description:
Somos uma indústria brasileira movida por propósito: transformar a cana-de-açúcar em soluções que geram energia, açúcar, combustível limpo e bem-estar para o mundo.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative — U.S. Home Service Software

Location: Remote — Brazil

Schedule: U.S. business hours

Company: Local Business Pro

Role Type: Full-time / Contractor to start

About Local Business Pro

Local Business Pro is a CRM, field service management, and AI-powered communication platform built for home service businesses.

We help companies like pest control businesses, HVAC companies, electricians, plumbers, arborists, general contractors, and other service-based businesses manage their customer relationships, jobs, follow-up, scheduling, payments, and communication in one place.

Our product is also heavily focused on AI. We are building tools that help local service companies answer calls, follow up with leads, organize customer communication, and automate parts of their operations so they can grow without losing the personal touch that makes their business successful.

We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative based in Mexico who can help us grow in the U.S. home service market.

About the Role

This is not a basic appointment-setting role.

We are looking for someone who can manage a full sales development pipeline, build and nurture relationships, understand customer pain points, and create qualified opportunities through consultative selling.

You will be working with U.S.-based home service companies and channel partners to introduce Local Business Pro, identify gaps in their current systems, and help move qualified opportunities toward demos, onboarding, and long-term customer success.

You will also play an important role in making sure new customers are handed off properly to our Client Success team. That means setting the right expectations during the sales process, documenting customer needs, and helping ensure that every new client has a strong start after they sign up.

What You’ll Do

You will be responsible for prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing sales opportunities with U.S. home service businesses.

You will manage your own pipeline inside our CRM, follow up with leads, book qualified demos, and help move opportunities through the sales process.

You will work with channel partners and referral partners to create joint-selling opportunities and build long-term relationships that lead to high-quality customers.

You will use consultative selling and gap-selling methods to understand where prospects are struggling with missed calls, poor follow-up, messy scheduling, disconnected systems, lack of visibility, or manual processes.

You will learn our software deeply so you can speak confidently about CRM, field service management, AI receptionist tools, automations, customer communication, and operational workflows.

You will help prepare strong handoffs to the Client Success team by documenting the customer’s goals, pain points, expectations, and setup needs.

You will help make sure customers are sold the right way, with clear expectations, so they have a higher chance of long-term success.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone with strong sales experience, excellent English, and the ability to speak confidently with U.S. small business owners.

The ideal candidate has experience selling or working with:

  • CRM software
  • Field service management software
  • SaaS products
  • Home service businesses
  • Marketing services for local businesses
  • AI, automation, or business operations software
  • Channel partners, referral partners, or joint-selling relationships

Experience with trades is a huge bonus, especially if you have worked with or sold to:

  • Pest control companies
  • HVAC companies
  • Electricians
  • Plumbers
  • Arborists
  • Roofers
  • General contractors
  • Lawn care or landscaping companies
  • Other local service businesses

You May Be a Great Fit If You

You have experience as an SDR, BDR, inside sales rep, appointment setter, account executive, sales consultant, or similar sales role.

You are comfortable calling, emailing, texting, and following up with prospects.

You know how to ask good questions and uncover real business problems.

You are not afraid of rejection and can stay consistent with follow-up.

You are organized enough to manage a pipeline without letting leads fall through the cracks.

You are tech savvy and comfortable learning new software quickly.

You are excited about AI and how it can help small businesses operate better.

You can communicate clearly with both prospects and internal teams.

You understand that a good sale is not just about closing the customer. It is about setting the customer up for success after they buy.

  • Fluent or near-fluent English
  • Able to work U.S. business hours
  • 2+ years of sales, SDR, BDR, or pipeline development experience
  • Strong phone presence and written communication skills
  • Experience using CRMs or sales pipeline tools
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting and follow-up
  • Comfortable working remotely
  • Reliable internet, computer, and professional work environment
  • Strong BonusesExperience selling CRM or field service management software
  • Experience selling to U.S. home service businesses
  • Experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldRoutes, or similar platforms
  • Experience with channel partner sales or referral partner relationships
  • Experience selling AI, automation, marketing, or operations software
  • Experience doing consultative selling, gap selling, or discovery-based sales

Compensation

Compensation will be based on experience and performance.

  • We are open to discussing a structure that includes base compensation plus performance bonuses for qualified demos, closed customers, and successful partner-driven opportunities.

title: Consultor(a) de Recrutamento
description:
Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e histórias profissionais.

Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) de Recrutamento com perfil consultivo, visão de mercado e forte orientação a resultados, capazes de conectar talentos às oportunidades certas e apoiar empresas em decisões estratégicas de contratação.

Quem somos e o que fazemos

Nossa missão é impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas e o crescimento das organizações, encontrando o profissional certo para o desafio certo. Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções especializadas em recrutamento e seleção para diferentes segmentos e níveis de senioridade.

Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e orientado à performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado. Nosso objetivo é que você prospere, se sinta valorizado(a) e tenha orgulho de fazer parte da nossa organização.

O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo;
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível;
  • Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Programas estruturados de treinamento, liderança e desenvolvimento de carreira personalizado;
  • Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para potencializar seu desempenho;
  • Programas de reconhecimento individuais, de equipe e em nível global;
  • Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.

Suas responsabilidades

Como Consultor(a) de Recrutamento, você atuará de forma estratégica e consultiva, sendo responsável por conduzir o processo de recrutamento de ponta a ponta e por construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e candidatos. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Busca ativa e atração de candidatos qualificados;
  • Mapeamento de mercado e identificação de talentos estratégicos;
  • Condução de entrevistas e avaliação de competências;
  • Gestão completa do processo de recrutamento, do briefing à oferta;
  • Atuação consultiva junto a clientes, compreendendo desafios e alinhando expectativas;
  • Orientação e acompanhamento de candidatos e clientes ao longo de toda a jornada de contratação;
  • Análise de mercado e compartilhamento de tendências e insights estratégicos.

Quem procuramos

Buscamos profissionais com perfil resiliente, curioso e orientado a resultados, que tenham:

  • Paixão por recrutamento e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Mentalidade consultiva e capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis;
  • Forte habilidade interpessoal e excelente comunicação;
  • Experiência na construção de relacionamentos com múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e de alta performance;
  • Mentalidade ética e responsabilidade sobre o próprio desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Graduação completa;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade

Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Somos uma empresa comprometida com a inclusão, equidade e respeito às diferenças, promovendo um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu máximo potencial.

Faça parte da nossa história

Se você busca uma carreira desafiadora, com impacto real na trajetória profissional das pessoas e no crescimento estratégico das empresas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

description:
Senior Java Backend Engineer / Service Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join a global technology team and work on the development, enhancement, and support of scalable back-end services and APIs.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, and production-grade service development .   • Integrate applications with relational databases, ensuring efficient data retrieval and query performance.
  • Collaborate with front-end and full-stack teams on application integration.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in enterprise applications.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and CI/CD processes.
  • Work with global teams in English.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Java back-end development .

  • Good understanding of object-oriented programming and clean code principles .
  • Experience with microservices and distributed applications.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar .
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance services.

Nice to have

  • Practical experience with JavaScript for application integration or light front-end enhancements.
  • Experience in enterprise or financial services environments.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Senior Java Engineer with strong back-end experience, good problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in complex enterprise environments. This is not an architect role; we are looking for someone who enjoys coding, improving services, solving technical issues, and contributing to high-quality software delivery.
